review_conflicts.details: Current portfolio 1288 apartments versus another Nam Long article 2104 / 15 blocks. Obtain original phase-wise sales inventory; do not choose.
Annual 2014 PDF text gives 449m VND for block C3/C4 dated 2014-05-11 but page image fetch timed out; hold out from price-observation numerator pending visual audit.
2020 source predicted Q2/2024; 2025 marketing says ready/target handover 2025. No official acceptance or first handover document crosschecked.
Issuer says sales-eligible. Need municipal construction authority sale eligibility list and foreign quota evidence before publishing.
New Saigon (1104 issuer units) versus commercial Hoang Anh Gia Lai 3 alias (~1000 broker) requires parcel and tower identity mapping.
2009 annual report table lists 152000 m2; project section shows 176685 m2. Scope/basis unknown.
1998 authority budget entry for damaged flats versus broker 1998 completed three blocks; don't assume same cadastral or completion identity.
2026 criminal-case evidence documents one unit allegedly sold without disposition rights; check individual unit legal title, not blanket label.
City letter 2412/UBND-DT 2006-04-14 quoted on broker pages but original missing; 170 flats refers to one block, not entire complex.
5 towers, 440 flats, 2006 completion are third-party claims, not officially confirmed.
sunwahpearls.com.vn contains consumer Gmail and is not proven official Sunwah Group project portal. Tower counts and product types require issuer evidence.
